title: Tara Glen

strings.lose: Not quite. Tap to try again
strings.fainted: You're knocked down. Back to the checkpoint.
strings.noAmmo: Out of water balloons. Find a tap!
strings.huntFail: Out of time. Talk to the kids to try again.
strings.rideHint: You'd need to be on the bike 🚲

swing.title: Aoife's Swing Contest
swing.help: Tap when the swing is at the very top. 3 in a row!

keepy.title: Big Mick's Keepy-uppies
keepy.help: Tap the ball to keep it up. Reach 10!

putt.title: Crazy Golf: Hole 9
putt.help: Drag back from the ball to aim, release to putt. Sink it in 3.

hunt.title: Starfish hunt
hunt.help: Grab all 6 starfish before the time runs out!

progression: talk sully -> give:fiver, give:coin, give:torch, set:sully_done
choose shauna: Pay the den fee (💶)
choose tadhg: Give him the cans

balloons.name: Water balloons
balloons.desc: Secondary attack: throw with the small 🎈 button. Refill at taps.

trainers.name: Trainers
trainers.desc: Proper grippy soles. You run a bit faster.

skateboard.name: Skateboard
skateboard.desc: Dodge further and slide under barriers.

bike.name: Bike
bike.desc: Tap 🚲 to ride. Crosses cattle grids.

can.name: Can of Club Orange
can.desc: A cold can of Club Orange, liberated from the groundsman's shed.

shell.name: Shells
shell.desc: Three on a string makes a necklace (+1 heart).

drive.name: Power Drive
drive.desc: Hold Attack to charge, release for a full drive swing all round you. Breaks armour and rotten wood.
drive.how: Hold ⚔️, let go when the ring glows.

chip.name: Chip Shot
chip.desc: Chip a golf ball at enemies or at things out of reach.
chip.how: Tap the small ⛳ button to chip a ball.

dashstrike.name: Dash Strike
dashstrike.desc: Attack during a dodge to lunge through enemies and squeeze through low gaps.

parry.name: Putt Parry
parry.desc: Tap Attack just as a shot reaches you to putt it straight back. Returned shots stun.
parry.how: Tap ⚔️ as a shot arrives to send it back.

combo4.name: Long Game
combo4.desc: Your combo gets a fourth, heavier swing.
combo4.how: Tap ⚔️ four times in a row.

fiver.name: Sully's Fiver
fiver.desc: Six quid for three golf balls. Five of it is the den fee.

recipes.text: Wheels on the deck. A skateboard.

text: A note from Mam on the table:
'Gone to the clubhouse quiz. Stay in the mobile.'

entities.locked: A tap. You've nothing to fill.

text: Trainers with grippy soles. You run a bit faster in these.
The Big Dust Bunny falls apart.

stats.name: The Big Dust Bunny
stats.bark: The Big Dust Bunny. Phases: chases, then charges, then spits and calls for help.

text: An old pram behind 210. You take the wheels.
A golf ball. Biscuit was lying on it.
You chip a ball up into the whin. Sully's ball drops out with it.
entities.locked: A golf ball's wedged high in a whin bush, SULLY written on it. Out of reach. A good chip would knock it loose.

text: A Club Orange from the groundsman's stash.
Another can. Two should do it.

entities.locked: Stairs down to the cellar. Pitch black. Something blinks down there.

text: Under a pile of bunting: a photo album. 'Tara Glen, Summer 1987'.
Big Gerry drops the flag and the terrace key, and flaps off out the window.

stats.name: Big Gerry
stats.bark: Big Gerry has the flag. His wings turn your swings while he hovers. Putt his shots back to knock him down; hit him when he charges.

text: Tucked in the roots: an old biscuit tin. Inside, a slice of Nana Breda's tart, wrapped in foil. Somebody hid it years ago and forgot.
Carved into the big beech: TOM + BREDA 1986.
Under it, smaller: 'the swing is OURS'.

lines: Wayne: Things have been off all day. Doors banging, dust moving on its own.
Want to know where to start?

reply: The empty mobiles are the worst. Something's nested in them.
Clear one out and the dust settles. For a while, anyway.

lines: Mrs Kehoe: My peg bag! You went into 131 for it? Good on you.
Take a sausage off the barbecue. And this string, you'll find a use for it.
Mrs Kehoe: Mind yourself out there.
Mrs Kehoe: The wind took my peg bag in through the window of 131.
Nobody's lived there since the Furlongs left. It's crawling with dust bunnies now.
Get it back and I'll see you right.
Mr Doyle: There's a bonfire on the strand tonight. Half the park's down there.
Mr Doyle: They've the road dug up at the bottom again.
Only way out of here now is through the Glen, and that's all briars.
Shauna: You're on Deco's team. Go on through, they're moving the goals.
Shauna: Is that a fiver? Den fee's five to get in the match.

reply: You play the last ten minutes. Final whistle goes, everyone drifts off to the chipper and the road clears.

lines: Shauna: This is the den's match. Den fee's a fiver to play, notes only.
Nobody's moving off this road till full time. Sully pays for lost golf balls, if you're skint.
Deco: Shauna does the money.
Aoife: Keep the deck. It needs wheels. There's an old pram behind 210.
Aoife: Nobody beats me on the swings.
Beat me and you can have my old skateboard deck.
Nana Breda: Where did you find this?
Summer 1987. That's my Tom with the fishing rod.
Keep the rod, love. He'd want it used.
And take a slice of tart for the road.
Nana Breda: Go on down to the bonfire. I'll watch from the step.
Nana Breda: Hello, pet.
I lost my photo album years ago, down in the clubhouse cellar.
Nobody goes down there now. Something lives in the dark.
Big Mick: Look after that BMX.
Big Mick: Ten keepy-uppies and the BMX is yours.
It's a moped in my heart.
Tony: Tony's Ices. Out of Club Orange, the groundsman bought the lot.
Out of cones too. It's been that kind of a day.
Biscuit takes the sausage and trots off.
He was lying on a golf ball.
Biscuit wags his tail.
Biscuit the dog is lying on something and won't budge.
He'd move for food.
Sully: All three! Two quid a ball, that's six.
Here's a fiver and a euro. And take the torch, the clubhouse cellar's black as your hat.
Sully: Keep off the greens.
Sully: I've lost three balls with my name on them. Two quid each if you find them.
Biscuit's lying on one, one's at the crazy golf, and one went in the whin.
Tadhg: I never saw you.
Tadhg: Is that two Club Oranges? ...Members only. But I'm parched.

reply: Tadhg: Go on so. Be quick.

lines: Tadhg: Clubhouse is members only tonight.
I'd murder a Club Orange, mind. Tony's sold out, the groundsman's hoarding them in his shed.
Róisín: Bonfire's lit. Your mam's down there looking for you.
Róisín: Strand's closed till the function's over. Gerry's been at the bins all day.
Sandy Acres kid: You got the flag back off Big Gerry. Fair play.
Sandy Acres kid: Big Gerry robbed your flag and flew into the clubhouse with it.
Sandy Acres kid: Tara Glen without a flag. Shame.
Father Murphy: Final round coming up.
Mam: Is that the Tara Glen flag? Off the Rock?
Dad: Well done. Nobody's got it back in years.
Mam: Come here and sit with us. Best summer yet.
Mam: There you are. Come sit by the fire.
Mam: What are you doing here? You're meant to be in the mobile!
Go on then. Be careful.
Dad: Grand fire.
Dad: Shh, music round.
Roadworks. A skip, a van and a trench right across the road. Nobody's getting out this way.
Playground. Under-12s only.
Beach: mind the gulls.
DANGER: deep water round the groyne at high tide.

locks.text: ROAD CLOSED. The barrier pole is too low to duck under. You'd need to slide under it on a board.
The road's washed out into a gully, and the bank drops away either side. Too far to jump on foot. On a bike, off the ramp, maybe.
The football match has the whole road blocked. Nobody's moving till full time.
Tadhg's on the rope. 'Clubhouse is members only tonight.'
The terrace gate down to the strand. Chained shut. Somebody inside has the key.
Brambles choke the gap into the trees behind 127. A charged drive would clear them.

doors.locked: A padlocked shed. The door's rotten at the hinges; a dash strike would burst it.

locks.text: A low gap under a wardrobe. You could lunge through it with a dash strike.
A low gap under a wardrobe. You could lunge through it with a dash strike.
A low gap under a wardrobe. You could lunge through it with a dash strike.
Pitch black. You need a torch.
A low gap under a wardrobe. You could lunge through it with a dash strike.
Pitch black. You need a torch.
Pitch black. You need a torch.
Pitch black. You need a torch.

say: Tadhg pockets the cans and lifts the rope.
By the time you're through, the sun's gone down behind the clubhouse. The lamps come on.
Down on the strand, someone's lit a bonfire.

tiers: Fill your balloons: combine the bucket with the pack.
Open your bag 🎒 and combine the balloons with the bucket.
🎒 → 'Pack of balloons', then 'Bucket of water'. The bucket's in the bathroom.
Beat the Big Dust Bunny in 131.
131 is just south-west of 127. Clear the room.
Clear 131. Its boss teaches you the Power Drive.
Clear the brambles behind 127 and go down through the Glen.
There's a gap in the trees just behind 127, choked with brambles.
Stand at the brambles, hold ⚔️ and let go when the ring glows.
Clear the arena in the Back Field.
Look for the marked square of grass in Playground Row.
Stand inside the marked square and beat both waves.
Build a skateboard: Aoife's deck and some wheels.
Win the swing game, then check behind Nana Breda's mobile (210).
Combine the deck and the pram wheels in your bag 🎒.
Slide under the ROAD CLOSED pole on the road south.
The pole is across the road at the bottom of Playground Row.
Face the pole and dodge on the skateboard to slide under it.
Win Big Mick's BMX at the roundabout.
Do ten keepy-uppies for Big Mick.
Talk to Big Mick by the roundabout on the Crescent.
Jump the washed-out gully onto the Links.
The road south off the Crescent drops into a gully. There's a ramp.
Get on the bike 🚲 and ride straight at the ramp.
Find Sully's three golf balls.
One's under Biscuit, one's at crazy golf, one's stuck in a whin bush.
Feed Biscuit the sausage, win crazy golf, chip the ball out of the whin. Then see Sully.
Pay Shauna the den fee to join the football match.
The match is blocking the road east. It's a fiver to join; Sully's paying for golf balls.
Talk to Shauna at the side of the match with Sully's fiver.
Learn the Dash Strike: clear the marked mobile on the Crescent.
One of the mobiles on the Crescent has something nasty in it.
Clear that mobile's room to learn the Dash Strike.
Get two cans from the groundsman's shed.
The shed is on Eighteen. Its door is rotten at the hinges.
Dash Strike the shed door, then grab both cans.
Bribe Tadhg with the cans to get to the clubhouse.
Tadhg's minding the rope into the clubhouse grounds.
Talk to Tadhg with two cans.
Clear the arena on the Ninth Hole.
The marked square of grass is out on the links. Beat every wave.
Win the Ninth Hole arena to learn Putt Parry: you need it for Big Gerry.
Take the flag back from Big Gerry in the clubhouse.
Big Gerry's flown into the clubhouse bar.
Swing just as one of his shots reaches you to putt it back. Hit him while he's dazed, or while he's charging.
Take the flag to the bonfire on the strand.
Go out the terrace gate behind the clubhouse.
Talk to Mam at the bonfire.
